scenes.title: Ночной звонок и тушёнка  (A Late-Night Call and Stewed Meat)
scenes.summary: Max wakes up to a late-night phone call from pregnant Vika asking him to bring her canned stewed meat.

scenes.title: Ночной визит к Вике  (A Night Visit to Vika's)
scenes.summary: Max brings Vika her midnight craving and is invited to stay the night until Vika's sister Tanya reminds them of their upcoming divorce.

scenes.title: Забытый день рождения  (The Forgotten Birthday)
scenes.summary: Elena hints about evening plans in the car, and Chef Barinov reveals he completely forgot that today is her birthday.

scenes.title: Обещанный сюрприз  (The Promised Surprise)
scenes.summary: Viktor covers up his memory lapse by claiming he planned a secret evening birthday surprise for Elena.

scenes.title: Столкновение бывшей и будущей  (Collision of the Ex and the Future)
scenes.summary: Elena and Eleonora collide in the hallway and in the parking lot, and Eleonora mocks Viktor when she hears today is Elena's birthday.

scenes.title: Ювелирный магазин и слухи  (The Jewelry Store and Rumors)
scenes.summary: Vika admits her pregnancy cravings to her sister, while Chef Barinov asks for the nearest jewelry store, sparking proposal rumors.

scenes.title: Массаж для беременных  (Pregnancy Massage)
scenes.summary: Tanya gives Vika the card of a pregnancy masseur and tells Max that Vika's hormones are making her crave intimacy.

scenes.title: Спор на коробочку  (Betting on the Little Box)
scenes.summary: Senya spots a velvet jewelry box in Chef Barinov's office and bets the cooks that it holds an engagement ring.

scenes.title: Совет по сюрпризу  (Advice on a Surprise)
scenes.summary: Max asks Kostya about pregnancy hormones, then advises Chef Barinov to sing a song for Elena's birthday surprise.

scenes.title: Песня в прачечной и пропавший кулон  (A Song in the Laundry Room and the Lost Pendant)
scenes.summary: While Chef Barinov rehearses a song and tango in the laundry room, Senya and Fedya accidentally lose his pendant.

scenes.title: Только завтрашний развод  (Only Tomorrow's Divorce)
scenes.summary: Max tries to seduce Vika based on her sister's hormone comment, and Vika angrily tells him she only wants tomorrow's divorce.

scenes.title: Мусоровоз и массажист  (The Garbage Truck and the Masseur)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya learn the chef's gift was hauled away in the trash, while Vika meets her pregnancy massage therapist.

scenes.title: Обручальное кольцо и подозрительная визитка  (The Engagement Ring and the Suspicious Card)
scenes.summary: Senya and Fedya buy an engagement ring to replace the chef's lost pendant, while Max and Kostya suspect Vika's masseur.

scenes.title: Проверка по телефону  (The Phone Test)
scenes.summary: Nastya calls the masseur to test him, and his flirtatious reply sends Max racing upstairs with a spare room key.

scenes.title: Вентиляция и преждевременные поздравления  (The Ventilation and Premature Congratulations)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov agrees to inspect the kitchen ventilation shaft while the staff prematurely congratulate Elena on getting engaged.

scenes.title: Тост и бархатная коробочка  (The Toast and the Velvet Box)
scenes.summary: Lyova escorts Elena to the table, where Chef Barinov gives a heartfelt birthday speech and presents the jewelry box.

scenes.title: Я согласна  (I Do)
scenes.summary: Elena sees the ring in the box and says 'I do,' but Viktor blurts out that he bought a pendant, humiliating her.

scenes.title: Кто подменил кулон  (Who Swapped the Pendant)
scenes.summary: After Max embarrasses himself in Vika's room, Chef Barinov confronts Senya and Fedya for swapping his pendant for a ring.

scenes.title: Разговор через вентиляцию  (Talking Through the Ventilation Shaft)
scenes.summary: Stuck in the ventilation shaft, Chef Barinov inspires Max to tell Vika through the air duct that he will always be there for her and their daughter.

scenes.title: Выходи за меня  (Marry Me)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov proposes to Elena from a horse-drawn carriage, Max and Vika finalize their divorce with hope left, and Kostya surprises Nastya.
